0022600108.text: The Washington Wizards, 1-1 and last out of a loss, visit the Chicago Bulls, also 1-1 and coming off a win, in the Wizards' third game of the season and their first road game, with Washington 5th in the East and Chicago 7th. The 2026-27 season series has no games yet, while the Wizards lost all three meetings in 2025-26, most recently 119-108 in Washington on April 9, 2026. Washington is without Jamir Watkins (out, knee surgery) and Tristan Vukcevic (out, hip pinched nerve), and AJ Dybantsa is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and a game-time decision. Chicago is without Nic Claxton (out, hamstring), and Noa Essengue is day-to-day with a head injury and a game-time decision.
